import random

r = random.Random(20260926)
n = 20000
m = 50000
perm = list(range(1, n + 1))
r.shuffle(perm)
lines = []
for i in range(n - 1):
    lines.append('%d %d %d' % (perm[i], perm[i + 1], r.randint(1, 100)))
for _ in range(m - (n - 1)):
    lines.append('%d %d %d' % (r.randint(1, n), r.randint(1, n), r.randint(1, 100)))
r.shuffle(lines)
print(n, m, perm[0])
print('\n'.join(lines))
